content:
maya: Heads-up — seeing sustained queue growth in us-west-2 over the last 30m. GPU pool at ~92% and egress queue p50 latency climbing. Thinking we should enable geo-overflow steering to eu-west-1 for best-effort traffic, but worried about model parity and extra token egress costs. Any quick mitigation ideas?

deploy-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-us-west-2 utilization > 90% (sustained 12m). Incident ID: INC-2026-1849

owen: can do tiered steering. Route non-SLA traffic to quantized variants in eu-west, keep SLA traffic local. That limits cross-region token spend and keeps high-QoS paths intact.

sophia: agree but reminder — some tenants have region-only constraints. Need per-tenant routing flags and a hard deny for data-residency customers. Also we should project cost delta before flipping.

maya: yep — per-tenant routing. Also we should add an admission-control threshold for best-effort: start shedding at 90% pool util and throttle gradually.

owen: sketching quick policy:
```
routes:
  - match: region == 'us-west-2'
    when: pool_util > 0.90
    actions:
      - reroute: target = 'eu-west-1' model = 'quant-v1' scope = 'best-effort'
      - throttle: target = 'non_sla' percent = 50
      - fallback_sequence: ['local-quant-v1','local-fp16','eu-quant-v1']
```
That keeps prod local, shifts best-effort, and provides ordered fallback.

sophia: also add metrics: cross_region_tokens, routed_requests, and tag with tenant_id. Ops needs a budget-cap alert tied to cross_region_tokens > X per hour.

maya: nice. I'll open a playbook and ticket for runbook steps. Immediate ask: can someone reduce warm-pool priority for best-effort by 20% so we free up 1-2 GPUs? @owen

owen: on it. I'll bump weight for sla pools, lower warm-pool weights for replica sets serving best-effort, and push a canary change to 5% of traffic. will post PR link shortly.

maya: thanks. If we still see surge in 15m we flip geo-overflow and strictly throttle non-sla. Keep updates short here — status in 10m?

owen: :thumbsup: will update in 8m with telemetry after weight change.

sophia: adding cost projection in the ticket now, linking expected dollar delta and tenant exemptions.

maya: deployed playbook ticket created: TKT-2942. Linking here when added. Thx team.
